extracted.name: Lemon & poppy seed overnight oats
extracted.description: Enjoy the flavours of a classic cake in these overnight oats, featuring tangy lemon curd and both poppy and chia seeds for added fibre
instruction_lines: Tip the oats, poppy seeds and chia seeds into a jar or container, then pour in the milk and spoon over the Danone Skyr Plain Yoghurt and lemon curd. Mix well to combine, then cover and chill overnight (or at least for a few hours).
To serve, take the oats out the fridge and dollop on a tablespoon of yoghurt, a drizzle of lemon curd, some poppy seeds and pistachios, if you like.
